description: Compare two sets of Kubernetes manifests and report what applying the second will actually do. Objects are matched the way an apply matches them, by apiVersion, kind, namespace and name. Reports a change to a field that is immutable for that kind, where an apply fails and the object must be deleted and recreated; a change under the pod template, which recreates every pod; a replica change; an object that is gone, which an apply does not delete; and a change that recreates nothing. Pay 220000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

after.description: The manifests to be applied. YAML, read as a documented subset: block mappings and sequences, flow collections of scalars, block scalars, and multiple documents separated by ---. Anchors, aliases, merge keys and explicit tags are refused with the line rather than half parsed. Nothing is fetched: no cluster, registry or repository is contacted, so the documents supplied are the whole input.
after.example:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
  labels:
    app: web
spec:
  replicas: 5
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web-v2
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: ghcr.io/example/web:2.1.0
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 256M
            limits:
              cpu: 200m
              memory: 512Mi
          env:
            - name: DATABASE_PASSWORD
              value: hunter2
            - name: FEATURE_FLAG
              value: no
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  type: LoadBalancer
  selector:
    app: webserver
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 9090

name: kubernetes_manifest_diff

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

immutable_change_count.description: Fields changed that are immutable for their kind, where an apply fails rather than succeeding.

objects.description: Per object: whether it changed, whether it recreates pods, and which immutable fields changed. The field list considered is published rather than left unstated.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

restarting_object_count.description: Objects whose pod template changed, so every pod is recreated.

unchanged.description: True only when every object was compared and nothing differed.

title: Kubernetes Manifest Diff
